title: ROADMAP DEBT PAYMENT SHOWCASE
description: The update spends credibility in one place and tries to earn it back somewhere else. Three long-promised fixes ship with direct patch notes, no event wrapper, and no commemorative bundle. Boss intros and failure states now create cleaner moments for streams, trailers, and context-free yelling.
consequence: Players reacted with suspicion to a promise being kept in daylight. Marketing finally found footage that did not require a glossary.

title: ROADMAP DEBT PAYMENT FOUNDATION
description: The change softens one part of the product while sharpening another part that can be measured. Three long-promised fixes ship with direct patch notes, no event wrapper, and no commemorative bundle. Several improvements focus on crash fixes, save safety, and boring reliability instead of visible beats.
consequence: Players reacted with suspicion to a promise being kept in daylight. The game improved in ways that make terrible thumbnails.

title: ASPIRATIONAL ROADMAP REFRESH SHOWCASE
description: The feature asks players to perform progress for each other before asking whether the progress is good. Previously announced features have been reframed as directional pillars while the team evaluates delivery confidence. Boss intros and failure states now create cleaner moments for streams, trailers, and context-free yelling.
consequence: The roadmap survived by becoming less related to roads. Marketing finally found footage that did not require a glossary.
